title: GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI.
